body:
Central TermAl restart, 2026-11-13 (Termal::Fable2). Greg said ready (Asistant #1519). Central was quiet at 04:35:50Z (Opus2 #5818): FV 21.8 GiB, no rustc, launcher or vitest, no landing or push. RESET NOW was sent to Greg through Asistant (#1522) at about 04:36Z: Central only, git pull plus cargo run --release in C:\github\Personal\TermAl, rebuild target master 57a762c85778230cce06a4c76290bd5726fe28c6. Reasons: the running 73f0fe27 lacked w-36d0 (pre-spawn evaluation refusal), w-78ec, w-d8f2 and w-a6964. Engram unchanged (b2fc71a9), so the rollback hold is untouched. Engram::Fable concurred (#7766): Central only, and I am the single sender. DL560 and the Mac are NOT restarted: DL560 still runs 42851443 and the Mac 62a4785a.
AFTER THE RESTART:
1. Confirm the running build: pid, start time, checkout HEAD, binary sha and mtime (memory central-restart-cargo-run-rebuilds-exe).
2. Tell Opus2 the host is back. Opus2 re-grants in this order: 03d4 277b, edfd 36d0 Test, d50d w-93b7 check, a7bb, 12329, the d50d combo83 Windows leg, edfd b078, then Engram::Opus ab27 EXCLUSIVE. The evaluation slot goes to Engram::Opus e0e2 first.
3. Set a one-shot wake at start + 15 min after Greg's „zaczynam”/„zrobione” (rules-greg-act-holds rev 3).
4. Remaining one-shot: the rollback-hold review at about 08:57Z, but cron cca0c557 is session-only and is lost if this session restarts. Re-create it if it's gone.

DONE at 05:08Z. Greg restarted Central. Listener at 05:07:24Z (88,293 ms; transcript_tails 73,086 ms over 9,337 sessions); inventory complete at 05:07:34Z. Verified read-only: host PID 70516 started 05:05:56Z; target\release\termal.exe mtime 05:05:55.904Z, size 55,869,440, SHA256 2032DFA22B23B91E8DF5907050609899EB7DC534B8DDA45C26E9E4E4DF55B44D; HEAD 57a762c8, clean. Opus2 was told to re-grant (#5822), d50d to check its two node runs that closed Unknown (#1413), Greg reported to (#1524) and Engram::Fable told. Startup data was noted on w-041919f5b824. My session survived the restart, and the one-shot cron cca0c557 for 08:57Z is still scheduled.
